m: वैकालीन mf(ई)n. = वैकालिक above, W.
वैकाल m. (fr. वि-काल) evening, afternoon, W.
वैकालिक mf(ई)n. occurring in or belonging to the evening, W.
वैकालिक n. evening devotion, (or) an ev˚ meal, Vet.; Campak.
a: वैकालिक — a. (की f.), वैकालीन a. (नी f.) Relating to or occurring in the evening.

m: वैकालिकम् ind. in the afternoon, MW.
वैकारिक mf(ई)n. (fr. वि-कार) based on or subject to modification, modifying or modified, MBh.; Suśr.; Pur. &c.
वैकारिक m. a class of deities, MW.
(with काल) the time necessary for the formation of the fetus, Car.
वैकारिक n. emotion, flurry, R.
a: वैकारिक — a. (की f.) 1 Relating to modification. --2 Modifying. --3 Modified.

m: वैकारिक—बन्ध m. (in the Sāṃkhya phil.) one of the threefold forms of bondage, Tattvas.
वैकारि-मत n. g. राज-दन्तादि.
वैकार्य n. transformation, change, modification, MBh.
वैकासेय m. patr. fr. वि-कास, g. शुभ्रादि.
वैकायन m. a patr. Saṃskārak. (also pl.)
वैकंसेय m. metron. fr. वि-कंसा, g. शुभ्रादि.
वैकङ्क m. N. of a mountain, Pur.

s: puM, (vikaNkata eva । svArTe aR .) vfkzaviSezaH । vE~c iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । vftiNkaraH 2 SruvAvfkzaH 3 granTilaH 4 svAdukaRwakaH 5 vyAGrapAt 6 kaRwikArI 7 vikaNkataH 8 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (vikaNkatasyAvayavo vikAro vA । “palASAdiByo vA .” 4 । 3 । 141 । ityaY । vikaNkatanirmmitasruvAdO, tri । yaTA, SatapaTabrAhmaRe । 5 । 2 । 3 । 15 । “sa pAlASe vA sruve vEkaNkate vA ॥”)
v: pu॰ vikaNkata + svArTe'R । (vE~ci) 1 vfkzaBede । tasyedamaR । 2 vikaNkatasambanDini tri॰ ।
m: वैकङ्कत mf(ई)n. or वैक्˚ (fr. वि-कङ्कत) belonging to or coming from or made of Flacourtia Sapida, AV.; TS.; Br. &c.
वैकङ्कत m. Flacourtia Sapida, L.
वैकथिक mfn. = वि-कथायां साधुः, g. कथादि.

s: klI, (viSizwaH kakzaH vikakza urastatra Bavam । vikakza + aR .) tiryyagvakzolambimAlyam । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: na॰ viSezeRa kakzati vyApnoti aR । tiryyakkakzAvalambini hAraBede hemaca॰ । vun । vEkakzaka urasi apavItAkAreRa Dfte mAlyaBede amaraH ।
m: वैकक्ष n. (fr. वि-कक्ष) = वैकक्षक, Mudr. (v.l.)
an upper garment, mantle, L.
a: वैकक्षं — [विशेषेण कक्षति व्याप्नोति अण्] 1 A garland worn over one shoulder and under the other like the यज्ञोपवीत. --2 An upper garment, a mantle.

s: klI, (vEkakzameva । svArTe kan .) urasi tiryyak upavItavat kaRWAt kziptamAlyam । ityamaraH ॥
m: वैकक्षक (Kād.; Sadukt.) or वैकक्षिक, (Mudr.) or वैकक्ष्य (ib.; Jātakam.), n. a garland suspended over the shoulder.
a: वैकक्षकं, वैकक्षिकं — A garland worn over the left shoulder and under the right arm (like the यज्ञोपवीत q. v.).

k.v: प्रालम्बमृजुलम्बि स्यात्कण्ठाद्वैकक्षिकं तु तत्. यत्तिर्यक्क्षिप्तमुरसि शिखास्वापीडशेखरौ॥

m: वैकक्ष्यक (ifc. f(आ). ) a wrapper, mantle, Hcar.
वैकल्प n. (fr. वि-कल्प) dubiousness, ambiguity, indecision, MW.
optionality, A.
w.r. for वैकल्य, Mn.; MBh.; Rājat.
a: वैकल्पं — 1 Optionality. --2 Dubiousness, ambiguity. --3 Uncertainty, indecision.

s: tri, vikalpena BavaH । vikalpaSabdAt zRikapratyayena nizpannamidam ॥
v: tri॰ vikalpena prAptaH tatra Bavo vAWak । 1 pakzaprApte 2 pakzaBave ca ।
m: वैकल्पिक mf(ई)n. admitting of difference of opinion, optional, ĀrṣBr.; ĀśvŚr. &c.
a: वैकल्पिक — a. (की f.) [विकल्पेन प्राप्तः तत्र भवो वा ठक्] 1 Optional. --2 Dubious, doubtful, uncertain, undecided.

m: वैकल्पिक—ता, f. (Mṛcch., Sch.) or वैकल्पिक—त्व, n. (Siddh.) optionality.

s: klI, vikalatvam । vikalasya BAva ityarTe zRyapratyayena nizpannamidam ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 74 । 310 । “mfgANkadattasacivaM cakzurvEkalyamAgatam ॥”)
m: वैकल्य n. (fr. वि-कल) imperfection, weakness, defectiveness, defect, frailty (also -ता f., R.; w.r. वैकल्प-ता), Mn.; MBh. &c.
incompetency, insufficiency, W.
despondency, MBh.; MārkP. &c.
confusion, flurry, MBh. (v.l. वैक्लव्य).
a: वैकल्यं — [विकलस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Defect, deficiency, imperfection. --2 Mutilation, being crippled or lame. --3 Incompetency. --4 Agitation, flurry, excitement. --5 Nonexistence. --6 Weakness, imbecility.

m: वैकल्य—ता f., R.; w.r. वैकल्प-ता
वैकर्णायन (Cat.) or वैकर्णि (Saṃskārak.), m. patr. fr. वि-कर्ण.

s: puM, (vikarRasyApatyamiti । vikarRa + “vikarRaSuNgacCagalAt vatsaBaradvAjAtrizu .” 4 । 1 । 117 । ityaR .) vAtsyamuniH । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥ (janapadaviSezaH । yaTA, fgvede । 7 । 18 । 11 । “vEkarRayorjanAnrAjA nyastaH .” “vEkarRayorjanapadayorvidyamAnAn .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥)
m: वैकर्ण m. (fr. वि-कर्ण) N. of two tribes (du.), RV.
patr. fr. वि-कर्ण, PārGṛ. (accord. to Sch. N. of Garuḍa or of the wind)
a patr. (if a Vātsya be meant), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 117 (cf. वैकर्णेय).
वैकर्णेय m. patr. fr. वि-कर्ण (if a Kāśyapa be meant), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 124 (cf. वैकर्ण).
वैकर mfn. (fr. वि-कर) g. उत्सादि.
वैकरञ्ज m. (fr. वि-करञ्ज) a species of snake, Suśr.
वैकर्म m. N. of the Muni Vātsya, MW.
वैकर्त m. (fr. वि-कर्त) a partic. edible part of a sacrificial victim, (perhaps) the loin, AitBr. (Sāy.)
one who cuts up a sacrificial victim, a butcher, MW.
a: वैकर्तः — Ved. 1 A butcher. --2 A particular part of the sacrificial victim.

m: वैकर्तन mfn. (fr. वि-कर्तन) relating or belonging to the sun, Rāghav.
वैकर्तन m. N. of Karṇa (as son of the sun), MBh.
patr. of Su-grīva, Rāghav.
वैकर्तन—कुल n. the solar race, Uttarar.
वैकर्य mfn. (fr. वि-कर) g. संकाशादि.
वैकटिक m. (fr. 2. वि-कट, but cf. वेकट) a jeweller, Vcar.
(कु-वैकटिक m. a bad jeweller, Hcar.)
वैकट्य n. hugeness, horribleness, atrociousness, Sāh.
वैकयत m. g. भौरिक्य्-आदि.
वैकयत—विध mfn. inhabited by Vaikayatas, L.
वैकृन्त (?) m. mercury, L.
वैकृतापह mfn. removing or preventing change, W.

s: klI, (vikftameva । “sAnnAyAnujeti .” 5 । 4 । 36 । ityasya vArttikoktyA aR । vikAraH । yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 6 । 48 । 32 । “prAyeRa gatasattvAnAM puruzARAM gatAyuzAm । dfSyamAnezu vaktrezu paraM Bavati vEkftam ॥” durnimittam । yaTA, raGuH । 11 । 62 । “tatpratIpapavanAdivEkftaM prekzya SAntimaDikftya kftyavit ॥” taTAca mahABArate । 3 । 137 । 3 । “vEkftaM tvagnihotre sa lakzayitvA mahAtapAH । tamanDaM SUdramAsInaM gfhapAlamaTAbravIt ॥”) vIBatsarasaH । tadAlambane mAMsaSoRitAdO, tri । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ taTAca । “vikftaM vEkftaYca syAttacca vEkftyamucyate ॥” iti BaratadbirUpakozaH ॥ (vikArajAte । yaTA, BAgavate । 2 । 10 । 45 । “ayantu brahmaRaH kalpaH savikalpa udAhftaH । viDiH sADAraRo yatra sargAH prAkftavEkftAH ॥”)
v: na॰ vikftasya BAvaH aR । 1 vikAre 2 vIBatsarase tadA lambanamAMsaSoRitAdO vikftita AgataH aR । 3 vikftito jAte tri॰ “vEkftAstu taTA devAH” ।
m: वैकृत mf(ई)n. (fr. वि-कृति) modified, derivative, secondary (-त्व n., Lāṭy.), RPrāt.; TPrāt., Sch. &c.
undergoing change, subject to modification, Sāṃkhyak.; KapS.
disfigured, deformed, MBh.
not natural, perpetuated by adoption (as a family), Cat.
वैकृत m. N. of the Ahaṃ-kāra or I-making faculty, MBh.
of a demon causing a partic. disease, Hariv.
वैकृत n. (ifc. f(आ). ) change, modification, alteration, disfigurement, abnormal condition, changed state, MBh.; R.; Suśr. &c.
वैकृत n. an unnatural phenomenon, portent, Ragh.; VarBṛS.; Rājat.
mental change, agitation, MBh.; R. &c.
aversion, hatred, enmity, hostility, MBh.; Hariv.; Kathās.; Rājat.
a: वैकृत — a. (ती f.) 1 Changed. --2 Modified. --तं [विकृतस्य भावः अण्] 1 Change, alteration, modification. --2 Aversion, disgust, loathing. --3 Change in state, appearance &c., disfigurement; N. 2. 5. --4 A portent, any event foreboding evil; तत्प्रतीपपवनादि वैकृतं प्रेक्ष्य R. 12. 62. --Comp. --विवर्तः a {{woful->woeful||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}} plight, miserable condition, suffering; वैकृतविवर्तदारुणः Māl. 1. 39.

m: वैकृत—रहस्य n. N. of wk.
वैकृत—सर्ग m. a form of creation (opp. to प्राकृतस्˚), VP.
वैकृत—त्व n., Lāṭy.
वैकृत—वत् mfn. morbidly affected by (comp.), Rājat.
वैकृत—विवर्त m. a woeful plight, miserable condition, piteous state, Mālatīm.
वैकृति w.r. for वैकृत n., MBh.
वैकृतिक mf(ई)n. subject to change, Sāṃkhyak.
changed, incidental, MW.
(in Sāṃkhya) belonging to a Vikāra i.e. to a production or evolved principle (see वि-कार, प्र-कृति), ib.
a: वैकृतिक — a. (की f.) 1 Changed, modified. --2 Belonging to a Vikṛti q. v. (in Sāṃkhya phil.).

s: klI, (vikftameva । svArTe zyaY .) vIBatsarasaH । tadAlambane, tri । yaTA, -- “trizu vIBatsavikftaM vEkftyaM vitatantaTA ॥” iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: वैकृत्य mfn. changed (in form or mind), W.
वैकृत्य n. change, alteration, R.
change for the worse, deterioration, degeneration, Hariv.
ugliness, repulsiveness, Sadukt.
an unnatural phenomenon, portent, MBh.; VarBṛS.
aversion, disgust, W.
hostility, R.
woeful state, miserable plight, A.
a: वैकृत्यं — 1 Change, alteration. --2 Woful state, miserable plight. --3 Disgust.

m: वैकि m. a patr. g. तौल्वल्य्-आदि, Cat. (pl.)
वैकिर mfn. (fr. वि-किर) percolated, trickled through
वैकिर n. (with वारि) percolated water, Suśr.
वैक्लव n. (fr. वि-क्लव) bewilderment, despondency, Pur.
a: वैक्लवं, वैक्लव्यं — 1 Confusion, agitation, bewilderment. --2 Commotion, tumult. --3 Affliction, distress, grief; वैक्लव्यं मम तावदीदृशमपि स्नेहादरण्यौकसः Ś. 4. 5, Ve. 5, Mk. 3, Māl. 8.

m: वैक्लव्य n. id., MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv. &c.
frailty, feebleness, mental weakness, Kād.; Śak., Sch.
वैक्लव्य—ता f. = वैक्लव, R.

s: klI, (vikrAntyA dIvyati । vikrAnti + aR .) maRiviSezaH । tatparyyAyaguRO । “vEkrAntaYcEva vikrAntaM nIcavajraM kuvajrakam । gonAsaH kzudrakuliSaM jIrRavajraYca gonasaH ॥ vajrABAve ca vEkrAntaM rasavIryyAdike samam । kzayakuzWavizaGnaYca puzwidaM surasAyanam ॥ vEkrAntaM vajrasAdfSyaM vajravadrasavIryyakam । taTApyaBAve vajrasya grAhyaM vEkrAntamuttamam ॥ vajrAkAratayEva prasahya haraRAya sarvvarogARAm । yadvikrAntiM Datte tadvEkrAntaM buDEridaM kaTitam ॥” iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: na॰ svArTe aR । maRiBede vikrAntaSabde dfSyam ।
m: वैक्रान्त m. n. (fr. वि-क्रान्त) a kind of gem resembling a diamond (also ˚तक), L.
वैक्रिय mfn. (fr. वि-क्रिया) resulting from change, HPariś.
subject to change, Śatr.; Sūryapr.
वैकुघासीय mfn. (fr. विकुघास) g. कृशाश्वादि (v.l. वैकुत्यासीय).

a: वैकुंठः — 1 An epithet of Viṣṇu. --2 Of Indra. --3 Holy basil. --ठं 1 The heaven of Viṣṇu. --2 Talc. --Comp. --चतुर्दशी the fourteenth day of the bright half of Kārtika. --लोकः the world of Viṣṇu.

m: वैकुण्ठा (आ), f. Vaikuṇṭha's (Viṣṇu's) Śakti, Pañcar.
वैकुण्ठीय mfn. relating to Viṣṇu's heaven, Pañcat.

s: puM, kfzRaH । (yaTA, BAgavate । 1 । 15 । 46 । “te sADukftasarvvArTA jYAtvAtyantikamAtmanaH । manasA DArayamAsurvEkuRWacaraRAmbujam ॥”) indraH । iti medinI ॥ sitArjakaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH । asya vyutpattiryaTA । “vikuRWAyA apatyaM vEkuRWaH bAhvAdyata iti SivAditvAt zRaH । ‘cAkzuzasyAntare devo vEkuRWaH puruzottamaH । vikuRWAyAmasO jajYe vEkuRWe dEvatEH saha ॥’ iti vizRupurARam ॥ kiMvA kuRWatyanayA kuRWA mAyA । kuWi KowanavEkalyAlasye semaktAt saroriti aH । viviDA kuRWA mAyA vidyate'sya vEkuRWaH vikArasaMGeti astyarTe zRaH । vizRusahasranAmawIkAyAM SaNkarAcAryyastvAha viviDA kuRWA gateH pratihatistasyAH karttA iti vEkuRWaH । jagadAramBe viSizwAni BUtAni parasparaM saMSlezayan tezAM gatiM pratyabaDnAditi vA vEkuRWaH । ‘mAyAsaMSlezitA BUmiradBirvyomnA ca vAyunA । vAyuSca tejasA sArdDaM vEkuRWatvaM tato mama ॥’ iti SAntiparvvaRIti .” ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “kuRWaM jaqaYca viSvOGaM viSizwaYca karoti yA । vikuRWAM prakftiM vedAScatvAraSca vadanti tAm ॥ guRASrayeRa BagavAn tasyAM jAtaH svasfzwaye । paripUrRatamaM tena vEkuRWaYca vidurbbuDAH ॥” * ॥ asya nAmno mAhAtmyam । yaTA, -- “rAma nArAyaRAnanta mukunda maDusUdana । kfzRa keSava kaMsAre hare vEkuRWa vAmana ॥ ityekAdaSa nAmAni paWedvA pAWayedyadi । janmakowisahasrARAM pAtakAdavamucyate ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 110 aDyAyaH ॥ “sANketyaM pArihAsyaM vA stoBaM helanameva vA । vEkuRWanAmagrahaRamaSezAGaharaM viduH ॥” iti SrIBAgavate ajAmilopAKyAnADyAyaH ॥ * vizRuDAmaviSezaH । tadvarRanaM yaTA, -- “uparizwAtkziterazwO kowayaH satyamIritam । satyAdupari vEkuRWo yojanAnAM pramARataH ॥ BUrlokAt parisaMKyAtaH kowirazwAdaSa praBo । yatrAste SrIpatiH sAkzAt sarvvezAmaBayapradaH ॥ vEkuRWAduttare SEvo lokaH zoqaSakowayaH । tiryyageva mahArAja kElAsAKyastu parvvataH । pArvvatyA sahitaH SamBuryatrAste svagaRErvvftaH ॥” iti pAdme svargaKaRqe 6 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “amftaM SASvataM nityamanantaM paramaM padam । hiraRmayaM mokzapradaM brahmAnandasuKAhvayam ॥ evamAdiguRopetaM tadvizRoH paramaM padam । yadgatvA na nivarttante tadDAma paramaM hareH ॥ nahi varRayituM SakyaM kalpakowiSatErapi । api drazwumaSakyaM tadbrahmarudrAdidEvatEH ॥ jYAnena SAstramArgeRa drakzyate yogipuNgavEH । tat sTAnamupaBoktavyamavyaktabrahmasevinAm ॥ SrISANGriBaktisevEkarasABogavivarjjitAH । mahAtmAno mahABAgA BagavatpadasevakAH ॥ tadvizRoH paramaM DAma yAnti brahmasuKapradam । nAnAjanapadAkIrRaM vEkuRWaM tadDareH padam ॥ prAkArESca vimAnESca sODE ratnamayEryutam । tanmaDye nagarI divyA sAyoDyeti prakIrttitA ॥ caturdvArasamAyuktA hemagopurasaMyutA । caRqAdidvArapAlEstu kumudAdyEH surakzitA ॥ caRqapracaRqO prAgdvAre yAmye BadramuBadrakO । vAruRyAM jayavijayO sOmye DAtfviDAtarO ॥ kumudaH kumudAkzaSca puRqarIko'Ta vAmanaH । SaNkukarRaH sarvvanidraH sumuKaH supratizWitaH ॥ tasmin banDavinirmuktAH prApyante susuKaM padam । yaM prApya na nivarttante tasmAnmokza udAhftaH ॥ mokzaM paraM padaM liNgamamftaM vizRumandiram । akzaraM paramaM DAma vEkuRWaM SASvataM param ॥ nityaYca paramavyoma sarvvotkfzwaM sanAtanam । paryyAyavAcakAnyasya paraM DAmno'cyutasya hi ॥” iti pAdme uttaraKaRqe 29 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “antaHpuranivAsinyaH sarvvalakzaRaBUzitAH । tABiH parivfto devaH SuSume paramaH pumAn ॥ evaM vEkuRWanATo'sO nATate parame pade । tadvyUhaBedAllokAMSca vakzyAmi girije SuBe ॥ prAcyAM vEkuRWalokasya vAsudevasya mandiram । AgneyyAM lakzmIlokastu yAmyAM saNkarzaRAlayaH ॥ sArasvatantu nErftyAM prAdyumnaH paScime taTA । ratilokastu vAyavyAmudIcyAmanirudDaBUH ॥ ESAnyAM SAntilokaH syAt praTamAvaraRaM smftam । 1 । keSavakIrttyAdilokA dbitIyAvaraRaM taTA ॥ 2 ॥ matsyakUrmmAdilokastu tftIyAvaraRaM param । 3 । satyayutAnandadurgAvizvaksenagajAnanAH ॥ SaNKapadmaniDIlokAScaturTAvaraRaM smftam । 4 । fgyajuH sAmATarvvARo lokAdizu mahatsu ca ॥ sAvitryA vihageSasya Darmmasya ca suKasya ca । paYcamAvaraRaM proktamakzayaM sarvvavANmayam ॥ 5 ॥ SaNKacakragadApadmaKaqgaSArNgahalaM taTA । mOzalaYca taTA lokAH sarvvaSastrAstrasaMyutAH ॥ zazWamAvaraRaM proktaM SastrAstramayamakzayam । 6 । EndrapAvakayAmyaYca nErftaM varuRaM taTA ॥ vAyavyaM sOmyamESAnaM taptamaM muniBiH smftam । sADyA marudgaRAScEva ye cAnye ca divOkasaH ॥ nityAH sarvve pare DAmni viSvedevAstaTEva ca । te vE prAkftanAke'sminna nityAstridiveSvarAH ॥ tenAhaM vacmi mAye na saYcintya iti vE smftiH । evaM paraM padErnityEryuktErBogaparAyaREH ॥ divyABirmahizIBiSca rAjate vizRurISvari । na tadBAsayate sUryyo na SaSANko na pAvakaH ॥ yadgatvA na nivarttante yoginaH SaMsitavratAH । dvayEkamantranizWA ye te vE yAnti tadavyayam ॥ na m: वैकुण्ठ m. (fr. वि-कुण्ठ) N. of Indra, ŚBr.; KauṣUp.
of Viṣṇu (Kṛṣṇa), MBh.; Hariv. &c.
a statue of Viṣṇu, Rājat.
the 24th day in the month of Brahmā, L.
(in music) a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.
a kind of Ocimum, L.
N. of various men (esp. authors and teachers), Cat.

pl. or sg. (scil. गण) N. of a class of gods, Pur.
वैकुण्ठ m. n. Viṣṇu's heaven (variously described as situated in the northern ocean or on the eastern peak of mount Meru), Pañcat.; BhP. &c.
वैकुण्ठ n. talc, W.
